title: Checking the acceleration
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Independent probes, such as supernovae, the microwave background and galaxy surveys, constrain cosmological models in different ways. Combining them helps test consistency and uncertainty.

misconception: A learner may choose: One supernova determines every cosmological parameter perfectly
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Why do cosmologists combine supernova measurements with other observations?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Why do cosmologists combine supernova measurements with other observations? Different probes test expansion and structure with different uncertainties. Independent probes, such as supernovae, the microwave background and galaxy surveys, constrain cosmological models in different ways. Combining them helps test consistency and uncertainty.
Visual caption: Different probes, one model. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
